notes.visit_cost: ASSUMED: cost of one crew visit; no public figure found (ESMAP, off-grid paper)
notes.lead: ASSUMED: months from fault flagged to cell replaced (dispatch and repair)
notes.detect: ASSUMED: months before a plain string notices a fault (REON sensing makes this zero)
notes.down_cost: ASSUMED: cost per month the string is down, per kWh nameplate; energy value alone is about 3
notes.lam: ASSUMED: faults per cell-year; EPRI gives 0.04 to 0.14 % a year for whole stationary systems
notes.fade: ASSUMED: 0.004 to 0.012 follows from the 20,000-cycle claim (Tim Ren, unverified); lithium EVs measure about 0.02
notes.loss: ASSUMED: switch conduction loss; Tim Ren says 'very minimum, not none'
notes.slack: share of current the site can shed by stretching discharge; loss share falls in proportion (physics)
